edits.headline: Pope Leo XIV makes first state visit to France in 18 years
edits.subheadline: The pope said "authentic secularity" does not exclude religion, France 24 reported.
editorialBody: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Paris on the first papal state visit to France in 18 years, France 24 reported on 26 September.
The pope said "authentic secularity" does not exclude religion. France 24 also reported that he met migrants and marginalised people during the visit.
Iran proposed a seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, Al Jazeera reported on 26 September. The Wall Street Journal, citing US officials, reported that President Donald Trump rejected it.
Under the plan, the United States would release $12bn in frozen Iranian assets, lift oil sanctions on Iran and end its naval blockade of Iranian ports, Al Jazeera reported.

Trump called for arms control talks between the United States, Russia and China during a meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Washington, according to a White House statement reported by Sputnik.
Russia's Defence Ministry said its forces had taken Petropavlovka and Lozovaya in Kharkiv region and Maryino in Sumy region, Sputnik reported.
Angela Rayner criticised proposed changes to UK visa rules ahead of the Labour Party conference, BBC News reported.

Morocco's Authenticity and Modernity Party won 97 of 395 seats in the 23 September parliamentary election, according to provisional results announced by Interior Minister Abdelouafi Laftit, Al Jazeera reported.
